prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Gloria, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Gloria thinks the municipal pool has been badly maintained for years.
Change to make: CHANGE THE SOURCE: say the claim comes from a different, more convincing source (for example someone who works at the council).
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I just heard from a contact who works at the city council that the pool will be closed all summer due to a complete filtration system failure. It sounds like the facility has been a major safety hazard for a long time, so they're finally shutting it down for repairs."
text: I just heard from my cousin who is a senior engineer at the city council that the pool is officially closing for the summer because the filtration system is a total wreck. It’s exactly what I’ve been saying for years—the place has been a complete safety disaster waiting to happen.
